style: Dark, melancholic 1980s sci-fi film synth score for a lonely retro pixel-art space game, Vangelis-like deep space ambient: slow-evolving retro analog synthesizer pads with filter sweeps, a soft low 16th-note arpeggiator, a sub-bass drone on a pedal tone, a sparse lonely lead with slow vibrato, tape echo and vast reverb, lots of space, far-off rusted metallic percussion, a lonely cello, a soft felt piano and faint glass bells. Drifting past a dead frontier of rusted copper relays and cables gone green, far out at the edge of space. Cold, lonely, mysterious and desolate. Purely instrumental. Dm, 108 BPM.
